about.empoweringAfrica: Empowering Africa through Practical Skills & Excellence
about.bootskillsDesc: Bootskills connects learners with career-ready courses, internships, and project-based experiences across technology, business, and creative industries.
about.visionText: To become Africa's leading practical learning and professional growth platform, starting from Rwanda and expanding globally.
about.missionText: To empower individuals and organizations with real skills, real experience, and intelligent digital solutions.
about.storyText: Bootskills was founded by Manzi Alain Patrick Munyeshuri, a Rwandan technologist driven by the need to close the gap between education and employability.
about.trainingCoursesDesc: Practical, market-driven courses in Software Development, AI, Data Science, and Digital Skills.
about.structuredInternshipsDesc: Simulated workplace environments working on real projects with professional mentorship.
about.softwareAIDevDesc: Custom web, mobile, and AI-powered solutions for startups and enterprise systems.
about.innovationPlatformDesc: Open ecosystem for trainers, professionals, and companies to collaborate and innovate.
about.beliefText: We believe opportunity should not depend on location. Bootskills uses online and in-person delivery, remote collaboration, and affordable internet access to serve learners beyond major cities.
about.founderJoined: He was later joined by <1>KALISA Jonathan</1>, Co-Founder, who brought operational and technical leadership to help scale training programs, internships, and software delivery.
about.valueExcellenceDesc: We deliver the highest quality in all our training programs and technology solutions
about.valueIntegrityDesc: Honest and transparent in all interactions with students, partners, and clients
about.valueInnovationDesc: Embracing new ideas, technologies, and methodologies to stay ahead
about.valuePracticalLearningDesc: Hands-on, industry-focused training that prepares you for real-world challenges
about.valueCommunityImpactDesc: Creating lasting positive change in communities across Africa
about.valueGlobalStandardsDesc: International curriculum aligned with global industry requirements
about.centerOfExcellence: A Center of Excellence in Professional Growth & Skills Mastery
about.centerOfExcellenceDesc: We combine structured learning, hands-on practice, and real project experience to prepare learners for today's digital economy. Training delivered online and in person with dedicated mentorship.
about.missionShort: Empower individuals with practical, industry-ready technology skills through expert mentorship.
about.visionShort: To be Africa's leading center of excellence in professional education and innovation.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome, Student!
welcome.content: Welcome to the Bootskills Student Portal! 🎉 This quick tour will show you around so you can start learning, coding, and building your career with confidence.

sidebar.title: 📋 Sidebar Navigation
sidebar.content: This is your **navigation sidebar**. Use it to jump between all sections of your portal — dashboard, courses, projects, billing, and more.

dashboard.title: 📊 Dashboard
dashboard.content: Your **Dashboard** gives you a snapshot of everything: your XP, streak, level, enrolled courses, recent activity, and upcoming deadlines.

projects.title: 💼 Projects
projects.content: View and apply for **real-world Projects** posted by clients. Build your portfolio while earning experience.

courses.title: 📚 My Courses
courses.content: Your **Courses** section — browse enrolled courses, continue lessons, track progress, and complete assignments all in one place.

internship.title: 🏢 Internship
internship.content: Once you complete your courses, apply for **Internships** here. You'll get real work experience in your field.

schedule.title: 📅 Schedule
schedule.content: Your **Schedule** — view upcoming sessions, mentor calls, deadlines, and live classes in one calendar view.

billing.title: 💳 Billing & Payments
billing.content: The **Billing** section is where you manage payments. Enroll in paid courses, view your receipts, and track payment history. You can pay using mobile money or card.

certificates.title: 🎓 Certificates
certificates.content: Once you pass all your courses, your **Certificates** will appear here. Download and share them anywhere.

header.title: 🔝 Top Header Bar
header.content: The **top bar** gives you quick access to search, your XP/streak/level (for students), notifications, theme toggle, and your profile menu.

notifications.title: 🔔 Notifications
notifications.content: Stay updated! Your **Notification Bell** lights up when you get messages, assignment feedback, or important updates.

userMenu.title: 👤 Your Profile Menu
userMenu.content: Click your **Avatar** to access Settings, go back to the website, or Log Out. You can also restart this tour anytime from here.

ready.title: 🎉 You're Ready!
ready.content: **You're all set!** 🚀 Start by exploring your Dashboard, enroll in courses, and begin your learning journey. Need help? Click the chat bubble or visit the Help page. You can restart this tour anytime from your profile menu.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome, Trainer!
welcome.content: Welcome to the Bootskills Trainer Portal! 🎓 This tour will guide you through managing students, courses, assignments, and your professional activities.

sidebar.title: 📋 Sidebar Navigation
sidebar.content: Your **navigation sidebar** is your command center. Jump between courses, students, mentorship, schedule, and more from here.

dashboard.title: 📊 Dashboard
dashboard.content: The **Dashboard** gives you an overview of your students, pending reviews, active courses, and recent activity at a glance.

courses.title: 📚 My Courses
courses.content: Manage your **Courses** — create new lessons, track student progress, update content, and monitor completion rates.

students.title: 👥 Students
students.content: View your **Students** — see who's enrolled, check their progress, grades, and reach out to support them.

mentorship.title: 🤝 Mentorship
mentorship.content: Your **Mentorship** section — schedule 1-on-1 sessions, track mentoring hours, and manage your mentees.

internships.title: 🏢 Internships
internships.content: Supervise **Internships** — review intern progress, assign tasks, and provide feedback on real projects.

schedule.title: 📅 Schedule
schedule.content: Your **Schedule** — manage your availability, view upcoming sessions, and plan your teaching time.

header.title: 🔝 Top Header Bar
header.content: The **top header** shows your student count, active courses, pending reviews, and gives you quick access to notifications and your profile.

userMenu.title: 👤 Profile Menu
userMenu.content: Your **profile menu** — access settings, switch back to the website, or log out. You can restart this tour anytime from here.

ready.title: 🎉 You're Ready!
ready.content: **You're all set!** 🚀 Start exploring your dashboard, check your students, and manage your courses. Need help? The chat bubble is always there. You can restart this tour from your profile menu.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome, Admin!
welcome.content: Welcome to the Bootskills Admin Dashboard! 🛠️ This tour will walk you through managing users, courses, payments, projects, and the platform operations.

sidebar.title: 📋 Sidebar Navigation
sidebar.content: Your **sidebar** is the admin command center. Navigate Management, Projects, Content, Operations, and more from here.

dashboard.title: 📊 Dashboard
dashboard.content: The **Dashboard** gives you key metrics — total users, students, courses, revenue, and platform activity at a glance.

users.title: 👥 Users
users.content: Manage all **Users** — view, edit, assign roles, track activity, and handle student/trainer accounts from one place.

courses.title: 📚 Courses
courses.content: The **Courses** manager — create, edit, publish, and organize courses. Assign trainers, set pricing, and manage modules.

payments.title: 💳 Payments & Billing
payments.content: The **Payments** section — view all transactions, track revenue, manage refunds, and monitor payment statuses.

internships.title: 🏢 Internships
internships.content: Manage **Internship Programs** — create programs, track intern progress, and manage placements.

analytics.title: 📈 Analytics
analytics.content: **Analytics** — deep dive into platform metrics, student performance, course completion rates, and revenue trends.

header.title: 🔝 Top Header Bar
header.content: The **top header** shows key stats — total users, students, and courses. You also get notifications, theme toggle, and your profile menu here.

userMenu.title: 👤 Profile Menu
userMenu.content: Your **profile menu** — access settings, go back to the website, or log out. You can restart this tour anytime from here.

ready.title: 🎉 You're Ready!
ready.content: **You're all set!** 🚀 Start managing your platform from the Dashboard. The sidebar has everything you need. Replay this tour anytime from your profile menu.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome, Super Admin!
welcome.content: Welcome to the Bootskills Super Admin Panel! 🔐 This comprehensive tour covers system configuration, user management, financial operations, and more.

sidebar.title: 📋 Sidebar Navigation
sidebar.content: Your **sidebar** has everything — System management, Marketing, Analytics, User Map, and more. Each section has detailed sub-menus.

dashboard.title: 📊 Dashboard
dashboard.content: The **Dashboard** gives you the big picture — total users, students, trainers, revenue, and platform health.

users.title: 👥 All Users
users.content: **All Users** — full control over every account. Filter, search, edit roles, and manage the entire user base.

config.title: ⚙️ Configuration
config.content: **Configuration** — set platform-wide settings, pricing, feature flags, and global preferences.

commissions.title: 💰 Commissions
commissions.content: **Commission Config** — set commission rates for trainers, referral bonuses, and payout structures.

disbursements.title: 💸 Disbursements
disbursements.content: **Disbursements** — manage payouts to trainers and partners. View payment history and initiate transfers.

discountCodes.title: 🏷️ Discount Codes
discountCodes.content: **Discount Codes** — create and manage promotional codes, track usage analytics, and set discount campaigns.

refunds.title: 🔄 Refunds
refunds.content: **Refunds** — process student refund requests, review disputes, and manage the refund lifecycle.

header.title: 🔝 Top Header Bar
header.content: The **top header** shows real-time stats — total users, students, and trainers. Quick access to notifications and your profile.

userMenu.title: 👤 Profile Menu
userMenu.content: Your **profile menu** — settings, back to website, or log out. Restart this tour anytime from here.

ready.title: 🎉 You're Ready!
ready.content: **You're all set!** 🚀 You now know the key areas of the Super Admin panel. Start from the Dashboard and explore each section. Restart this tour anytime from your profile menu.

student.overview: The Student Portal is your learning command center. Here you'll access courses, track progress, manage payments, apply for internships, and earn certificates. Everything you need to go from beginner to job-ready professional.

trainer.overview: The Trainer Portal gives you everything you need to manage courses, mentor students, grade assignments, and track your professional activities. Welcome to the teaching team!

admin.overview: The Admin Dashboard is your platform management center. Here you control users, courses, payments, projects, internships, and platform analytics. Everything runs through here.

superAdmin.overview: The Super Admin Panel gives you complete control over the entire platform. System configuration, financial operations, user management, marketing tools, and advanced analytics are all at your fingertips.
